summary: IsoEnergy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing assay results from its 2026 winter exploration drilling program at the Larocque East project in the Athabasca Basin. The news release reports high-grade uranium mineralization intersected along the Hurricane South Trend, including up to 4.21% U3O8 over 3.5 m. No special-situation transaction such as merger, acquisition, divestiture, or capital return is involved. This is a routine operational update regarding exploration results and future drilling plans, not a special situation event.
